phases.title: Mesocycle 1 — Rebuild the Catch
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–6: receiving positions, full extension, confident turnover and repeatable footwork. Week 6 builds to heavy with technique as the limit.

intent.title: Week 1 · Build the Receiving Shape
intent.text: Catch width, lockout and confident receiving.

exercises.name: Drop snatch (PVC / empty bar) + OHS
exercises.note:
PVC or empty bar by control; hold the catch for 2 sec.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DCJLYWGEdzo

exercises.name: High-hang power snatch + OHS
exercises.note: Finish the leg drive; lock arms immediately and squat without jumping wider. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: PVC or empty bar, high-hang power receive then controlled squat. Do not force a deep catch.

exercises.name: Overhead squat hold, light (2 sec)
exercises.note: Lock elbows; bar over mid-foot. Light load (~50% snatch) — enough to feel real overhead stability before squatting heavier.

exercises.name: Back squat, 3-sec eccentric
exercises.note: Stable whole foot; knees follow toes throughout the descent. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Back extension + hollow hold (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: controlled back extensions into a hollow body hold. Keep it light and clean — quality over fatigue.

exercises.name: Tall clean + unloaded split freeze
exercises.note: Fast elbows, then balanced feet; mark landing positions.

exercises.name: High-hang clean
exercises.note: Secure the rack before standing; elbows fast, whole foot down. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: high-hang power clean + front squat.

exercises.name: Split jerk, 2-sec split hold
exercises.note: Vertical dip, punch and split together; hold the split 2 sec before recovering. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: PVC or empty bar; footwork first, load second.

exercises.name: Front squat, 3-sec eccentric
exercises.note: Elbows high; knees travel in line with feet. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: DB Bulgarian split squat + ring row (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: single-leg strength and stability, then horizontal pull for upper back. Upright torso, full range.

mobility.name: Banded RDL (long-arm pull)
mobility.load: Light band around forearms / empty bar
mobility.note: Band looped around forearms behind the back; hinge keeping arms long and lats engaged — grooves the strong-back finish for the clean pull.

exercises.name: Segment snatch pull to knee
exercises.note: One-second knee pause; long arms and bar close.

exercises.name: Low hang snatch
exercises.note: Low hang (below knee); push and accelerate straight to the hip, no pause. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: work above knee. If the bar drifts, reset at high hang rather than adding weight.

exercises.name: Snatch pull, 1-sec knee pause
exercises.note: Pause balanced over the bar at the knee, then drive to full extension. No arm bend. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: use snatch load, not pull load; position over weight.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Own the bottom; smooth ascent with no knee collapse. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Pendlay row + dead bug (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: strict rows from the floor for lats and upper back, then anti-extension core. Flat back, no hip drive on rows.

exercises.name: Paused clean pull + muscle clean + split-foot steps
exercises.note: Arms long through knee; add a muscle clean to finish the pull upright before landing on separate tracks.

exercises.name: Pause-at-knee clean + split jerk
exercises.note: Patient to knee, aggressive leg drive, fast elbows, vertical dip. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: above-knee clean and empty-bar split rehearsal if the pause disrupts balance.

exercises.name: Clean pull, 1-sec knee pause
exercises.note: Same knee position as the clean; finish tall, shrug, no early arm pull. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: stay at clean load and nail the pause.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Elbows lead up; chest remains supported. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Goblet reverse lunge + single-leg calf raise (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: quads and glutes through a long step back, then ankle stiffness for the jerk drive.

mobility.name: Barbell front-rack stretch
mobility.note: Fingertips on bar, drive elbows up and forward; open lats and wrists for a relaxed rack.

intent.title: Week 3 · Extend, Then Commit
intent.text: Long arms, fast turnover and a predictable landing.

exercises.name: Tall snatch + 2-sec overhead hold
exercises.note: Fast turnover, full elbow lock, no unnecessary foot jump.

exercises.name: Hang snatch + snatch
exercises.note: Recreate the same footprint and complete extension in both starts. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: two high-hang singles rather than a floor combination until both catches are committed.

exercises.name: Snatch high pull
exercises.note: Full leg extension first, then elbows high and out; bar stays close. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: stop at the shrug (snatch pull) if arms bend early.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Deliberate lower; track knees through the sticking point. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Seated DB strict press + Nordic hamstring curl (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: overhead strength with no leg drive, then eccentric hamstring strength. Ribs down on the press; lower slow on Nordics.

exercises.name: Tall clean + rack hold
exercises.note: Turn elbows around quickly; stand only after a balanced catch.

exercises.name: Hang clean + clean
exercises.note: Two clean receives, same rack and footprint each time. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: one hang clean per set until the floor start is consistent.

exercises.name: Push press + split jerk
exercises.note: Same dip for both; drive the press, then punch and split decisively on the jerk. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: empty bar or light; prioritize two-track feet.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Keep elbows high while driving out of the hole. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: DB box step-up + chest-supported DB row (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: drive through the whole front foot without pushing off the back leg, then squeeze shoulder blades on the row.

mobility.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
mobility.note: Squeeze the back-leg glute, ribs down; opens the rear-leg position for the split jerk.

exercises.name: PVC snatch balance + OHS hold
exercises.note: Punch to locked elbows; hold 2 sec in the bottom.

exercises.name: No-foot power snatch
exercises.note: Use the drill to eliminate backward kicks, not to eliminate normal foot movement forever. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: PVC or empty bar; film a successful landing and compare with Week 1.

exercises.name: Snatch-grip RDL
exercises.note: Deload: smooth hinge, lats on, bar brushing the thighs. Easy positional work. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: empty bar or light.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Easy speed; no grind or positional compensation. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W raise + side plank (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: deload: lower-trap and rear-delt endurance for overhead position, then lateral trunk. Easy effort.

exercises.name: Tall clean + jerk footwork on tape
exercises.note: Fast elbows and steady split geometry.

exercises.name: Clean, 2-sec catch hold
exercises.note: Freeze the rack in the bottom 2 sec, then stand. Deload — film one rep. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: power catch + controlled squat.

exercises.name: Split jerk, 2-sec split hold
exercises.note: Freeze rack before dip; move confidently to the split and confirm two tracks on video. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: separate footwork from jerk loading.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Smooth descent; full foot remains planted. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge + tempo push-up (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: deload: glute activation and controlled pressing. Leave plenty in the tank.

mobility.name: Goblet squat pry
mobility.note: Sit in the bottom, elbows push knees out, shift side to side; own the bottom position.

intent.title: Week 5 · Return to the Full Lift

exercises.name: No-foot high-hang snatch
exercises.note: Finish vertical drive without the feet shooting backward.

exercises.name: Snatch
exercises.note: Long arms to extension; receive in the same balanced footprint. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: high hang or blocks. Successful confident receiving beats a heavier floor rep.

exercises.name: Snatch pull
exercises.note: Same start and posture as the snatch; finish tall and fast. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: snatch-weight pulls only.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Leave 1-3 clean reps in reserve. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Snatch-grip behind-the-neck press + single-leg DB RDL (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: overhead pressing strength in the snatch receiving position, then hinge balance and hamstrings. Press from a stable trunk.

exercises.name: Tall clean + tall jerk drill
exercises.note: Fast rack then rapid arms without an excessive press-out.

exercises.name: Clean & split jerk
exercises.note: Finish through upper thigh; stand and reset before a decisive jerk. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: power clean + clean front squat at controllable load; PVC/empty-bar jerk.

exercises.name: Clean pull
exercises.note: Patient off the floor, full extension, bar close. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: clean-weight pulls only.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Strong rack; evenly loaded feet. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: KB front-rack walking lunge + ab wheel rollout (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: front-rack posture under fatigue in the legs, then anti-extension core. Elbows up, no ribs flaring.

mobility.name: 90/90 hip switches
mobility.note: Tall torso, rotate through the hips; prepares hips for a deep, upright receive.

intent.title: Week 6 · Build to Heavy
intent.text: Heaviest technically excellent lift, not a max-out. A PR or an 80% lift with excellent form are equally successful; no required max.

exercises.name: Tall snatch + bottom freeze
exercises.note: Fast elbows, firm lockout, committed receiving.

exercises.name: Snatch: BUILD TO HEAVY
exercises.note: Build only while lockout, width and confidence remain excellent; no prescribed %. Coach films/records the best made rep. · Beginner: build to a best repeatable technical rep, even if it is an empty bar. · A great rep at 80% is as successful as a great PR. Stop before form deteriorates.

exercises.name: Snatch pull
exercises.note: Use today's best snatch as the load; fast, tall finish. · Beginner: same load as your best rep today.

exercises.name: Back squat, light technique sets
exercises.note: Smooth and fast, several reps in reserve. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Strict pull-up + reverse hyper (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: build-to-heavy day, so short and crisp: vertical pull for lats, then posterior chain decompression. Band-assist pull-ups as needed.

exercises.name: Tall clean + split freeze
exercises.note: Elbows through; stable split and straight arms.

exercises.name: Clean & jerk: BUILD TO HEAVY
exercises.note: Only increase with decisive rack, clear jerk lockout and stable split. Coach films/records the best made rep. · Beginner: use high-hang clean and an appropriate jerk variation; stop at first loss of confidence. · A great rep at 80% is as successful as a great PR. Stop before form deteriorates.

exercises.name: Clean pull
exercises.note: Use today's best clean as the load; fast, tall finish. · Beginner: same load as your best rep today.

exercises.name: Front squat, light technique sets
exercises.note: No grind. Strength is not the benchmark today. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Goblet Cossack squat + half-kneeling KB press (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: lateral hip strength and adductor range, then single-arm overhead press with a level pelvis.

mobility.name: Barbell front-rack stretch
mobility.note: Fingertips on bar, drive elbows up and forward; open lats and wrists for a relaxed rack.

phases.title: Mesocycle 2 — Express the Lift
phases.subtitle: Weeks 7–12: faster pull-under, consistent catch positions, meaningful loads and a true same-day Olympic total.

intent.title: Week 7 · Reset for Reactive Speed
intent.text: React and receive at moderate loads.

exercises.name: Tall snatch into 2-sec hold
exercises.note: Instant lockout; feet land quietly.

exercises.name: High-hang snatch + snatch
exercises.note: Match catch width and receiving confidence in both positions. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: high-hang power snatch + OHS.

exercises.name: Snatch balance
exercises.note: Fast drop under, punch to lockout, ride to the bottom. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: PVC/empty bar or pressing snatch balance.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Rebuild volume; steady tempo with 2+ reps in reserve. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Barbell good morning + hanging knee raise (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: spinal erector and hamstring strength for holding back angle in the pull, then hip flexor and lower-ab strength. Soft knees, neutral spine.

exercises.name: Tall clean + dry split jerk
exercises.note: Fast elbows and simultaneous punch/feet.

exercises.name: High-hang clean
exercises.note: No unnecessary kick-back; meet the bar and secure the rack. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: high-hang power clean + front squat.

exercises.name: Jerk dip + split jerk
exercises.note: Pause-free dip and drive, then the full jerk; vertical torso throughout. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: empty bar step-to-split.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Smooth front rack; controlled volume. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Front-foot-elevated split squat + DB bench press (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: deep front-knee range for clean recovery and split strength, then horizontal pressing for balance. Control the bottom of each rep.

mobility.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
mobility.note: Squeeze the back-leg glute, ribs down; opens the rear-leg position for the split jerk.

intent.title: Week 8 · Power Through the Hip
intent.text: Speed above knee and a completed hip finish.

exercises.name: Snatch-grip segment pull
exercises.note: Patient to knee, long arms, finish tall.

exercises.name: Above-knee hang snatch
exercises.note: Violent leg drive without an early curl; pull under as bar rises. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: high hang or power catch, then controlled overhead squat.

exercises.name: Snatch pull from above knee
exercises.note: Same hang position; aggressive hip finish, then shrug. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: snatch-weight pulls only.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Repeat depth and stable knee line. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust + bottoms-up KB press (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: glute strength for the hip finish, then shoulder stability through a strict overhead press. Squeeze at the top of every thrust.

exercises.name: Clean high-pull shape + muscle clean + tape-track split
exercises.note: Finish legs before arms; add a muscle clean to finish the pull upright, then split — do not jump back.

exercises.name: Above-knee hang clean + split jerk
exercises.note: Bar close to upper thigh, fast elbow turnover, vertical jerk. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: muscle clean / high-hang catch with light jerk footwork.

exercises.name: Clean high pull
exercises.note: Legs finish first, then elbows high; keep the bar close. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: stop at the shrug if arms bend early.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Avoid elbow drop on last rep. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Single-leg KB RDL + strict chin-up (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: single-leg hinge strength, then lats and biceps for keeping the bar close. Band-assist chin-ups as needed.

mobility.name: Barbell front-rack stretch
mobility.note: Fingertips on bar, drive elbows up and forward; open lats and wrists for a relaxed rack.

exercises.name: Pause-at-knee snatch deadlift
exercises.note: Hold knee position 1 sec, then extend without curling.

exercises.name: Snatch, 1-sec knee pause
exercises.note: Stay over bar, push through legs, no wild foot spread. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: below-knee hang; no loaded position they cannot hold.

exercises.name: Halting snatch deadlift
exercises.note: Lift to just above the knee and hold 2 sec — shoulders over bar, back locked. Lower under control. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: snatch-weight; position over load.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Strong ascent; stop before form changes. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Weighted chin-up + GHD sit-up (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: heavier vertical pull, then trunk flexion through range. Partial-range or AbMat sit-ups for anyone new to the GHD.

exercises.name: Pause-at-knee clean pull + tall clean
exercises.note: No rushed knee passage; elbows are fast after extension.

exercises.name: Clean, 1-sec knee pause
exercises.note: Balance through the knee, then aggressive leg drive and fast elbows. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: clean above knee; no compromised pause.

exercises.name: Push press + split jerk
exercises.note: Same dip for both; commit to the split and lock out. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: empty bar or light jerk footwork.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Drive tall with elbows high. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: DB lateral lunge + Pallof press (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: frontal-plane leg strength and adductors, then anti-rotation core. Sit back into the hip, knee tracks toes.

exercises.name: Tall snatch, lockout freeze
exercises.note: Quick punch under, no soft elbows.

exercises.name: Snatch
exercises.note: Push from floor; bar accelerates past knee; finish and receive. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: use 60-70% or RPE 6, even if established lifters progress past 80%.

exercises.name: Power snatch
exercises.note: Speed work: fast, high finish and a crisp power receive. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: hang power snatch, light.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Keep 1-2 reps in reserve; zero grinding. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Barbell strict press + single-leg hip thrust (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: strict overhead strength, then glute strength one side at a time. No leg drive on the press.

exercises.name: Tall clean + empty-bar jerk dip
exercises.note: Fast elbows; straight vertical dip.

exercises.name: Clean & split jerk
exercises.note: No arm pull early. Rack securely before split, punch to lock. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: high-hang clean + light jerk; meet the bar and stand decisively.

exercises.name: Clean pull
exercises.note: Fast through the knee, full extension; low reps, high quality. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: clean-weight pulls only.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Full-foot pressure under a stable rack. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Weighted back extension + hanging L-sit hold (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: loaded spinal erectors, then compression strength. Tuck the knees on the L-sit if needed.

mobility.name: Goblet squat pry
mobility.note: Sit in the bottom, elbows push knees out, shift side to side; own the bottom position.

exercises.name: No-foot high-hang snatch
exercises.note: Reinforce a quiet, repeatable receiving footprint.

exercises.name: Snatch
exercises.note: Advance only on completely stable makes; no grinding or press-out. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: RPE 6-7 with repeatable catches; skip near-max percentages.

exercises.name: Snatch pull
exercises.note: Low volume, fast and tall; arrive fresh for total week. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: snatch-weight pulls only.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Fast reps, at least 2 reps in reserve. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Ring dip + side plank hip dip (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: heavy-singles week, so low volume: triceps and shoulder strength for the lockout, then obliques.

exercises.name: Tall clean + dry split jerk
exercises.note: Confidence under the bar and crisp feet.

exercises.name: Clean & split jerk
exercises.note: No hesitation in rack or jerk; sharp lockout. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: RPE 6-7 and well-controlled receiving; no pressure to reach 90%.

exercises.name: Split jerk from rack
exercises.note: Heavy jerk confidence before the total: one dip, one drive, stick the split. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: RPE 6-7 jerk you can stick every time.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Clean positions, 2+ reps in reserve. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Chest-supported T-bar row + Copenhagen plank (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: mid-back thickness for a solid rack, then adductor strength. Short-lever Copenhagen (knee on bench) for most.

intent.title: Week 12 · Taper + Saturday Total
intent.text: Monday primer and Saturday same-day Olympic total. Monday prepares; Saturday scores best snatch + best clean & jerk on the same day.

exercises.name: Tall snatch + OHS hold
exercises.note: Set stance and punch to a decisive lockout.

exercises.name: Fast snatch singles
exercises.note: Crisp and easy: all makes, no heavy attempts, no missed reps. · Based on SN 1RM

exercises.name: Snatch pull, fast
exercises.note: Speed only; leave the gym fresh. Plan warm-up jumps and openers with your coach after. · Based on SN 1RM

exercises.name: Back squat, very easy
exercises.note: Explosive intent, minimal fatigue; skip if needed. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Band face pull + dead bug (superset)
exercises.note: Superset: taper week: easy shoulder health and core control. No fatigue before Saturday.

exercises.name: Tall snatch + tall clean
exercises.note: Empty bar openers: snap under, find your footprint, then start warm-ups.

exercises.name: Snatch — official attempts
exercises.note: 17–31 min: up to 3 official attempts, after snatch warm-ups (08–17 min). Best made snatch counts toward Saturday total. No forced misses.

exercises.name: Clean & Jerk — official attempts
exercises.note: 40–57 min: up to 3 official attempts after C&J warm-ups (31–40 min). Add best made C&J to best made snatch. No squats.
